item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R13-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R13-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R13-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The submission identified use of the death penalty in Egypt as a human-rights concern.","notes":["The excerpt supports identifying Amnesty International’s findings regarding use of the death penalty, but does not establish that its use was continued."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R13-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The submission identified torture and other ill-treatment in Egypt as human-rights concerns.","notes":["The excerpt states that Amnesty International provided findings in relation to torture and other ill-treatment; it does not independently establish a broader reported pattern."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R13-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The submission identified arbitrary deprivation of liberty and unfair trials in Egypt as human-rights concerns.","notes":["The excerpt supports Amnesty International’s findings in relation to these issues, but does not provide further case-level detail."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R13-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R13-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R13-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The document is a submission to the UN Human Rights Committee’s 137th session, scheduled for 27 February–24 March 2023.","notes":["The excerpt supports the document’s status as a submission and gives the session dates, but does not explicitly state that Amnesty International submitted its findings or that the session was held."]}]}
